editorial.evidence: Read all 43 captured sections against the draft. The source repeated the same design four times (interview guide, deep dive, cheat sheet, full design); the walkthrough follows the full design's order (questions, requirements, sizing, architecture, ingestion, gate, residency, reliability, audit, evaluation, trade-offs) and folds the interview-guide and deep-dive versions into the matching step or into a deep dive only where they add mechanism (three timestamps, idempotency key per resolution version, model inputs as regional data, operating metrics). All 16 SVGs are placed as eight light/dark pairs beside the prose that reads them. Added teaching material is labelled illustrative: the $320 Frankfurt parcel, the 0.99-confidence customs trace through both gate orderings, the 3,000-row batch diff and the S:resolution-v1/v2 key trace. The brief opens on the stalled shipment and defines exception, webhook, batch drop, EDI, idempotency key and circuit breaker before use; no approval role was invented beyond the source's ops agents. All 11 Check Yourself questions, 10 follow-ups, the architecture prompt, the two-minute answer and the cost pivot are worked-answer reveals. Source section numbers in moved tables were rewritten to step names. Open items kept explicit: the confidence threshold and shadow agreement target are unspecified in the source. November 20 complete maintained-baseline review: Complete maintained casebook: eleven walkthrough steps, eight protected figures, both feed paths, all gate rules, Frankfurt example, regional topology, execution trace, SAP/weather/manager variant, evaluation and all practice answers.
